Results.ReviewText: This grill is the standard. I have owned several Webber kettles over the years and they were all great for the job at hand, but this one is the best. Incremental improvements in the ash catcher, handles, lid are thoughtful, meaningful changes.
Results.Title: Premium charcoal grill 22 inch

Results.ReviewText: I have done gas grills, pellet grills/smokers and now I am back to my favorite.  The extremely versatile Weber 22" kettle one touch.  You can customize this grill to do any stye of cooking with simple lump charcoal and have excellent results.
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd 22in kettle since 1975. Always a quality product at a great price.  Hard to believe it could be made better, but the ash catcher and thermometer are great additions.
Results.Title: Quality, price and durability.

Results.ReviewText: Charcoal that went or fell through to the bottom of bbq stays lit as it cannot be closed off.
Results.Title: Bbq at bottom stays hot

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill as a gift, lot of room w this grill, the heat is perfect.I also got the Weber charcoal starter, WOW! That thing really works well. I’m looking at purchasing the rotisserie that Weber offers.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: Have a gas grill but wanted to get back to basic charcoal for a real BBQ taste.
Results.Title: Can't beat the taste of a charcoal cooked meal.

Results.ReviewText: If you want to use charcoal, Weber's design for heat control is about as good as it gets.  I would have given it five stars but the piece that holds the ash pot has come apart resulting in an insecured ash pot.
Results.Title: As good as it gets . . .

Results.ReviewText: Excellent piece of equipment. Competitors can’t come close to this quality.
Results.Title: Superb

Results.ReviewText: My first charcoal grill and I love it. Fully recommend this.
Results.Title: Love this!

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Il serait très utile d’avoir un vidéo démontrant l’usage du grill tel que la pose du charbon, l’allumage des briquettes ect.
Results.Title: L’utilisation

Results.ReviewText: Just replaced our old Webber, it lasted 22 years!  I expect this new one will outlive me!
Results.Title: Quality of the Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very good grill.  Easy to use and clean.  Assembly is a bit more difficult than it needs to be.  Recommend the YouTube video instead of the manual.
Results.Title: Great affordable grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber and it is definitely a great start. This is probably the best kettle grill I have ever owned. I only wished I had known about the Master Touch because for the small price increase, it is worth it with the additional accessories it brings. Maybe in a few years when I need to add an additional grill, I will go for it.
Results.Title: My first Weber, exactly what I wanted.

Results.ReviewText: Love it.  Have a pellet smoker, but needed something to better handle grilling this summer.  This grill works so well and is so easy to use and control.   Happy BBQ/griller here.
Results.Title: Very pleased

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product that will last for years. I recommend this to anyone who is looking for a new grill.
Results.Title: Quality Product

Results.ReviewText:
…you know I grabbed the 22” Kettle Webber b/c I am waiting to replace rusted out gas grill.
   
Based on my first experiences, I can become a charcoal snob over gas.  

The downloaded App specialized for grill is FANTASTIC, with great recipes, helpful timers & simple guidance for the amateur griller! I am a new fan of the always respected Webber brand
Results.Title: Newfound Appreciation for Charcoal

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill and used it extensively in rain, snow, and sunshine for 15 years.  I believe it would have lasted another 5 years easily if I had not been so hard on it.  It fell out of the back of my truck and broke the riveted handle off leading to its retirement.  By this time, my family of six was now down to just me, so I bought a Smokey Joe.
Results.Title: I loved this grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Very easy to assemble, great quality! 
Before grilling - watch the videos so you dont burn your meat!

Great purchase!
Results.Title: Love my new grill!

Results.ReviewText: As good as we remembered years ago before we had a gas grill.  Weber is hands down tastier!!!
Results.Title: Weber Is Better!!!

Results.ReviewText: My first grill, this thing is awesome! We grilling everything up in here, just the best!
Results.Title: We Grillin’!!!!!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience did not match your expectations! We love to listen to ways that we can enhance our fan's grilling experience. We appreciate your suggestions, and we are sure to pass them along to the appropriate team. If we can help with anything else, please do not hesitate to reach out! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
**really wanted to love this grill but here are a few things that could improved for a better user experience:

1.- (hook) the cover hook should be painted with a different color that the cover otherwise is really difficult to located the when you need it ( marking the location of the hook on the outside can be also appreciate in that way the end user knows exactly where is located and no need to look for it when grilling )

2.-(lock) adding a lock-in system so the cover is secure when the  unit is not used or is transported on a vehicle (camping, etc)

3.-(stability) adding another leg  with out a wheel can improve the stability when grilling or moving the unit.
Results.Title: Amazing but needs improvement

Results.ReviewText: Great on its own. Would be terrific packaged with a charcoal chimney and a rain cover. The green finish, handles and foldable inner grate are like a perfect rub on select brisket.
Results.Title: 22” premium green kettle

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with purchase.  Good quality product, easy to use, flavor if charcoal is fantastic!
Results.Title: Excellent quality!

Results.ReviewText: It is an awesome and affordable grill. It can be used open or covered and the thermostat (a new feature that wasn’t on my previous one) is very useful as I use it and an instant read thermometer to obtain perfect results and not over cook meats and veces.
Results.Title: Using the Weber Kettle Grill effectively.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill. I have always used a propane grill. It is very easy to use and to clean.  I have grilled beef pork and chicken.  Food is tasty with no chemical taste to it.  The grill surface is more than adequate.  I am totally pleased.  This grill is really fun to use and easy to use, especially when I use a chimney to start my charcoal.  I am sorry it took so long to make the switch to this charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Totally pleased

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback! We are so sorry to learn about the trouble with attaching your lid to the lid holder during use. We are sure to pass your feedback along to our team. If you have any other questions or concerns, please let us know! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Lid holder is hard to use when grill is very hot..
Results.Title: Weber grill 22

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Excellent produit. À la hauteur de mes attentes, pas étonnant.
Results.Title: C'est mon deuxième Kettle, pourquoi changer?

Results.ReviewText: The lid vent should have a handle , it gets extremely hot.
Results.Title: 22” Premium Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Easy to set up, and easy to clean. I love my grill
Results.Title: Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText:
Beautiful dark green color. Easy to put together by yourself, good instructions just follow the diagrams you’ll do fine. Highlights for me: hanging hook for the heavy lid, it works a couple different ways it can hang on the side or cover up in part for your cooking temp preferences. 2nd grate hinges are on both sides such a nice touch. 
I purchased other items to go with and haven’t been disappointed at all. Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22’

Results.ReviewText: Grill I use every day. Well built and ready to use
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill is as advertised.  Very happy with it. Weber lives up to their reputation as usual.
Results.Title: Money well spent

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. It works good and runs fine. The cleaning blades make it easy to clean out the ashes. Definitely a keeper.
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: First Weber grill. Learning also. My suggestion is to buy the grill that is one upgrade to this one that has the better grate, taller legs, and lid holder. You will save money buying the upgraded grill for around 230.00 than buying all these accessories individually.
Results.Title: New griller. Suggested the upgraded Weber Kettle

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
